about: This page is React (MusicPage.jsx, its frame generated from the legacy markup). It OWNS the music engine, src/pages/music/engine.js: the legacy music chunk moved verbatim but for the bridge rewrite (tools/tests/engine-verbatim.test.js), now the sound library, each scene's ambient bed and imported music. The page registers every engine function on window while mounted; what core and the sound dialog in ModalHost call by name is in provides.
